jobDescription.name: About the role
jobDescription.value:
As a Franchise Founder Associate, you will be the first point of contact for a fixed portfolio of our franchise partners who operate Loco Chicken outside Germany. You are the interface between the partners and headquarters in Berlin. You answer their questions, bring the right people together, and work directly with them to make their business better. This role does not yet exist in this form. You are helping to build it.

You will:

  • Lead partners: You know the numbers of every location, set priorities, keep your commitments, and say clearly when something is not working.
  • Improve the business: You work with partners on levers such as opening hours, delivery areas, menu, staff planning, and promotions. You implement measures together and check afterwards whether they worked.
  • Orchestrate internally: You get answers from Ops, Supply Chain, Tech, Marketing, and Finance, and come back to the partner with a solution.
  • Analyze performance: You build your own analyses, find out why a location is declining or outperforming, and derive two to three measures the partner can implement.
  • Run business reviews: At a fixed cadence, you review P&L, goals, and measures with each partner.
  • Secure standards: You visit stores, coach on quality and customer experience, and are clear when necessary.

jobDescription.name: About you
jobDescription.value:
To be successful in this role, you bring:

  • First franchise insights: You have seen franchising or food service systems from the inside, e.g. through an internship, a project or a role on the franchisor or franchisee side.
  • Business or operations background: You have a degree or apprenticeship with a business focus, or operational management experience in hospitality or food service.
  • Numbers under control: You understand KPIs such as revenue, conversion, availability, cancellations, ratings, food cost and labor, and you read a P&L on your own. You derive actions from them: hypothesis, test, result.
  • AI in your daily work: You use AI every day for analysis, process design and automation, and you think in prompts, templates and workflows.
  • Confident with tools: You work confidently with dashboards, spreadsheets and ticketing systems and quickly find your way around them. SQL is not required.
  • Persuasive leadership: You win over entrepreneurs rather than instruct them, and you enforce standards without losing the relationship.
  • Clear communication: You explain numbers so that partners act on them, and you align internal stakeholders on a shared goal.
  • Languages: Negotiation-proof English and good German for collaboration in the Berlin team.

From creating and launching new brands to scaling existing ones, your contributions will span the full spectrum of brand management.

  • Influencer Marketing: Identify, onboard, and manage influencers globally while working closely with existing brand creators to amplify visibility and build authentic connections.
  • ATL Media Buying: Handle large-scale media buying for TV, print, and OOH campaigns across international markets.
  • PR & Communications: Develop and execute communication strategies to enhance brand perception and drive engagement worldwide.

jobDescription.name: About the role
jobDescription.value:
As a EiR intern, you work closely together with our Venture development team and our founder associates. You jump between departments and get hands-on at those specific projects that you are most excited about: tech, operations, finance, marketing, data and much more.

  • Learn everything about Entrepreneurship (by doing it)
  • Get assigned one direct mentor from the leadership team to support your growth
  • Rotate between 2 departments (tech, finance, marketing, project management)
  • Join monthly exclusive talks from EU’s best founders - held only for the LANCH Team
  • Learn how to raise money in a full-day coaching session (incl. a call with a VC General Partner) → Pitch deck writing, fundraising strategy, team selection
Location: Berlin, Germany
Start Date: ASAP

What you will do:
  • Project management: You will work on various important projects simultaneously that include multiple different stakeholders from both inside and outside of the organisation.
  • Build playbooks: As a EiR intern, you will implement and improve operational processes across the entire organisation. Enabling us to scale our business.
  • Know the numbers: You will work together with multiple stakeholders in the organisation and use your excellent analytical skills to evaluate trends. Enabling us make the right decisions for company.

jobDescription.name: About you
